elements.quote: Through an integrative review, we aimed to identify approaches to evaluate the sustainability of evidence-based interventions (EBIs) and sustainability outcomes.
elements.reason: Explains the importance and need for conducting the review by stating its aim.

elements.quote: A focus on evaluation is what differentiates this review from recent syntheses published on approaches to sustainability research.
elements.reason: Explains the need for the current review by citing and differentiating from previous syntheses ([6-10]).
This review focuses on evaluation approaches, not intervention effects, so describing mechanism of action does not apply.
This review is methodological and does not involve complex interventions or delivery contexts requiring a logic model.

elements.quote: The aim of this integrative review was to identify and synthesize approaches that have been used to evaluate the sustainability of EBIs in healthcare. We aimed to enhance our understanding of sustainability definitions, research designs, data collection methods, timing, measures, and sustainability outcomes used for sustainability evaluation studies.
elements.reason: Objectives are explicitly stated but no question-formulation framework is mentioned.
The review focuses on evaluation approaches, not intervention effects, as stated in the aim.

elements.quote: Articles were included if they: • Were published in a peer-review journal • Were primary research • Had explicit research design and data collection methods • Had an explicit theoretical approach a for sustainability (theory b , model c , framework d , instrument e , method, checklist, process, strategy, conceptualizations, development, pilot test and/or tool f ) • Were within a healthcare setting g • Evaluated the sustainability of an EBI
elements.reason: Specifies study characteristics including designs, settings, and eligibility criteria.

elements.quote: We only included published studies in the English language and peer-reviewed primary studies in this review.
elements.reason: Specifies language and publication status, but dissemination year is not mentioned.
Exclusion criteria do not distinguish between outcomes not measured and not reported; based on evaluation presence.
No evidence of synthesis groups specified or linked to objectives.

elements.quote: This review entailed a comprehensive search of published literature and rigorous review methods; however, we recognize that there is the possibility of incomplete retrieval of identified research. For example, all gray literature was excluded.
elements.reason: Rationale provided for gray literature exclusion, but not for other restrictions like language.

elements.quote: In December 2018 and July 2020, we searched the following databases: Ovid MEDLINE(R) and Epub Ahead of Print, In-Process and Other Non-Indexed Citations and Daily (1946 to current); OVID Embase (1974 to current); EBSCOhost CINAHL Plus with Full-text (1937 to current); Wiley Cochrane Library (inception to current).
elements.reason: The search dates for each database are reported, with coverage dates provided.
